cohort: 630 newborns admitted to the National Reference Center for Neonatology and Nutrition at Children's Hospital, University Hospital Centre IbnSina of Rabat between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2022, divided into two groups: those with respiratory distress (n=421) and those without (n=209).
finding: Neonatal respiratory distress was found to be associated with maternal anemia, diabetes, caesarean section, and prematurity.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with neonatal respiratory distress (OR = 4.23; CI 95 (1.54-11.59); p = 0.001).
